title: Companies (Management by Administrator) Rules, 1993
caution: Made under the Companies Ordinance, 1984, which the Companies Act, 2017 repealed; confirm whether it is still in force.

preamble: Division Notification No. S.R.O. 698(I)/86, dated the 2nd July, 1986, the Corporate Law Authority hereby makes the following rules, the same having been published previously as required under the said section 506, namely:- THE COMPANIES (MANAGEMENT BY ADMINISTRATOR) RULES, 1993 PARTI Preliminary

sections.title: Short title and commencement
text: (1) These rules may be called the Companies (Management by Administrator) Rules, 1993.
(2) They shall come into force at once.

sections.title: Definitions
text: (1) In these rules, unless there is anything repugnant in the subject or context,-
>(i) "Ordinance" means the Companies Ordinance, 1984 (XLVII of 1984);
and
>(ii) "section" means a section of the Ordinance.
(2) All other words, terms and expressions used but not defined in these rules shall have the same meanings as are assigned to them in the Ordinance.
Representation to the Authority

sections.title: Several creditors may join in one representation
text: All creditors may be joined in one representation or the representation may be made by one or more creditors whose debt or aggregate debt is not less than sixty per cent of the paid up capital of the company.

sections.title: Documents to be accompanied with representation
text: (1) The representation under rule 3 shall be in the form of an application to the Authority and shall be supported by such information as specified in the Annexure to these rules.
(2) A representation shall be accompanied, (a) by supporting documents referred to or relied upon. alongwith three years; and
III - 13
>(b) by the original receipt of the fee paid under rule 8. 2 (3) The application shall be in triplicate.

sections.title: Register of Representations
text: The Authority shall cause the particulars of every application to be entered in a register to be kept for the purpose called "Register of Representations under section 295", entries wherein shall be serially numbered in every year and the number in the register shall be endorsed on the application which shall be borne by all proceedings thereunder.

sections.title: Notice to parties
text: When a representation has been duly made by an application, notice shall be issued to the company and all others concerned to appear and show cause why the application should not be accepted.

sections.title: Disposal of representations
text: (1) The Authority shall except in extraordinary circumstances and on grounds to be recorded, hear the representation on day to day basis and shall dispose it of within sixty days of its receipt.
(2) In dealing with a representation under sub-rule (1) the provisions of section 478, shall as far as possible, be applicable.

sections.title: Fee
text: A fee of ten thousands rupees shall be payable for making a representation to the Authority under sub-section (1) of section 295.
PART-III
Management by the Administrator

sections.title: Management of company
text: Where an administrator has been appointed he shall manage the company in accordance with the provisions of the Ordinance, the rules made thereunder and in accordance with such directions, not inconsistent with the provisions of the Ordinance or rules made thereunder, as the Authority may give from time to time.

sections.title: Best possible profits and benefits to be earned
text: The be earned. administrator shall manage the affairs of the company and carry on its business in the best possible manner so as to earn the best possible profits and benefits for the company and its members and creditors.

sections.title: Handing over of company's affairs
text: In the event of an order under sub-section (6) of section 295 whereby the purpose of the order for appointing the administrator has been fulfilled and the company has been permitted to appoint directors, on appointment of such directors, the administrator shall hand-over the management and affairs of the company including records thereof, to the said directors.

sections.title: Appointment of committec
text: The Authority may appoint a committee consisting of representatives of the creditors and shareholders to offer its comments and suggestions to the Authority regarding the administrator with particular reference to:—
>(a) the affairs of the company;
>(b) disposal of capital assets; and
>(c) any other related matter.
